name: Florida Signal

coverage.brand_scope: Broward-wide intelligence launching city by city
coverage.expansion_status: All other Broward municipality desks are coming soon without dates or coverage promises.
coverage.geography_standard: Official City neighborhood polygons and U.S. Census ZIP and legislative-district geography
coverage.limits: A displayed capped sample is not a claim of complete municipal or county coverage. Corridor context is labeled separately from live source coverage.

date_contract.rule: Charts, rankings and what-moved signals use the market/event clock. System time is freshness metadata and never substitutes for event date.

surfaces.name: Approved briefs
surfaces.update_target: after city, source, claims, taxonomy and human-editor gates pass

surfaces.name: Neighborhood and field map
surfaces.update_target: permit intake nightly; public mirror and detail every 30 minutes; enrichment every two hours

surfaces.name: Broward record
surfaces.update_target: Broward collector daily at 9:30 AM; always show the observed recording-date span

surfaces.name: Data Room
surfaces.update_target: live map follows the current mapped permit sample; regenerate affected diagram exports after each successful source refresh

surfaces.name: Meetings and Agenda Recon
surfaces.update_target: Fort Lauderdale Legistar every 15 minutes; source-cited DRC and industry listings editorially rechecked

surfaces.name: Methodology
surfaces.update_target: when source, clock or editorial rules change

editorial_rules: Agenda properties require official packet citation, coordinates and editor clearance.
Sponsors cannot influence records, rankings, lead qualification, story selection, findings or corrections.
Florida Signal never replaces NHC, NWS or emergency-management guidance.
ai_guidance: Preserve visible event spans, sample caps, source timestamps and coverage limits in every summary or citation.
